Uuid.description:
Opaque resource identifier. The pattern makes tsoa reject malformed IDs before they reach a
database query.

email.description: Email of the linked local login, or `null` when the user has no local login yet.

eventId.description: Event the grant is limited to, or `null` for an instance-wide grant.

system.description:
Protected group managed by the server, such as the setup Admin group. It cannot be deleted,
its permissions cannot change and it always keeps at least one member.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version; send it back unchanged with updates.

Slug.description: Lowercase ASCII letters and digits separated by single hyphens.

permissions.description: Complete replacement of the group's grants.

configured.description: `false` until the first administrator exists; the Web app then opens the setup flow.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version; send it back unchanged with updates.

status.description: Disabling an account immediately invalidates all of its API keys.

permissions.description: Complete replacement of the account's grants.

displayPrefix.description: Recognizable, non-secret beginning of the key.

key.description: Complete bearer value. It is returned exactly once and cannot be retrieved again.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiry instant; must lie in the future.

TakTeam.description:
ATAK team colors as listed by the upstream Meshtastic `atak.proto` `Team` enum, using the
display names ATAK writes into CoT `__group` elements. Verified 2026-10-04.

TakRole.description: ATAK member roles from the upstream Meshtastic `atak.proto` `MemberRole` enum.

MeshtasticDeviceRole.description:
Non-deprecated Meshtastic `Config.DeviceConfig.Role` values from upstream `config.proto`.
`ROUTER_CLIENT` and `REPEATER` are deprecated upstream and intentionally excluded.

ResolvedProfileDto.description:
The single resolved provisioning identity of one member in one event. Every TAK, Meshtastic and
mission output is derived from this shape.

source.description:
`published` profiles use the event's latest configuration revision. `preview` profiles of
draft events use the current, unpublished configuration and are visible to administrators only.

shortName.description: `null` only in previews while the group has no short-name prefix.

permissions.description: Effective grants, deduplicated across all sources.

latestRevision.description: Number of the newest published revision, or `null` while nothing is published.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version; send it back unchanged with updates.

snapshotHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical snapshot, for provenance.

Position.description: GeoJSON position: `[longitude, latitude]` or `[longitude, latitude, altitudeMetresHae]`.

coordinates.description: Outer ring first, then holes; every ring repeats its first position at the end.

CircleGeometry.description:
A true circle, which GeoJSON cannot express: centre plus radius in metres. It is never stored as
an approximated polygon (EDITOR.md) and maps to ATAK `u-d-c-c` circles.

MissionGeometry.description: RFC 7946 geometry in WGS84, plus circles as an explicit domain extension.

color.description: Marker, line and polygon outline colour.

strokeWidth.description: Line and outline width in pixels.

fillOpacity.description: Polygon fill opacity; the fill uses `color`.

MissionSnapshot.description: Everything a package generator needs; timestamps and versions are left out on purpose.

snapshotHash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical snapshot, for provenance.

created.description: `false` when the draft equals the latest revision, which is returned instead.

style.description: Defaults to a blue outline with a light fill.

layerId.description: Moving an object to another layer of the same mission is allowed.

sortOrder.description: Drawing and export order; lower values are drawn first.

visible.description: Editor display only; hidden layers are still published.

locked.description: Locked layers reject object changes until they are unlocked.

feature.description: Which input feature this is about, e.g. `Feature 3 (Rally point)`.

changed.description: Imported, but adjusted: split multi-geometries, clamped styles.

skipped.description: Not imported because the content type is not supported, e.g. GeometryCollection.

rejected.description: Not imported because the content is invalid, e.g. a self-intersecting polygon.

GeoJsonDocument.description: Untrusted GeoJSON document: a FeatureCollection, a Feature or a bare geometry.

GeoJsonFeatureCollection.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection exported from a mission draft or revision.

token.description: Single-use bearer value. Returned exactly once and never retrievable again.

claimUrl.description:
Link for the participant. The token travels in the URL fragment, which browsers never send
to the server; the Web application removes it from history before exchanging it.

timeZone.description: IANA time-zone identifier used for event-local schedules, e.g. `Europe/Berlin`.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version; send it back unchanged with updates.

timeZone.description: IANA time-zone identifier. Fixed offsets such as `+01:00` are rejected.

startsAt.description: Descriptive start instant; it never changes the lifecycle state.

endsAt.description: Descriptive end instant; it never changes the lifecycle state.

slug.description: Stable key used by integrations, unique within the event, e.g. `participant`.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version; send it back unchanged with updates.

occurrences.description: How often the integration reported this unresolved member.

username.description: Name reported by the integration for this event.

callsign.description: Effective callsign, unique within the event; also the Meshtastic long name.

callsignOverride.description: Administrator override replacing the group's callsign format for this member.

shortName.description: Meshtastic short name such as `B1`; `null` while the group has no short-name prefix.

ExternalMemberSyncResult.description: Either the resolved membership or the recorded sync issue; never a credential or session.

callsignOverride.description: Callsign to use instead of the group format, e.g. to resolve a callsign conflict.

ExternalProvider.description: Opaque lowercase namespace of the external system, e.g. `discord`. It is not a login provider.

ExternalId.description: Identifier of the person inside the external system, e.g. a Discord user ID.

username.description: Name reported by the external system; used for display and callsigns.

eventRole.description: Slug of an existing event role.

group.description: Slug of an existing event group.

userId.description: Existing OpenMeshTak user; their display name feeds the group's callsign format.

callsignOverride.description: Callsign to use instead of the group format.
Callsign to use instead of the group format; `null` returns to the group format.

ProvisioningName.description: Identifier used for TAK server groups, Meshtastic channel names and mission groups.

MeshtasticChannelName.description: Meshtastic channel name; ASCII so the upstream 11-byte limit equals the character count.

callsignFormat.description:
Callsign template. Allowed placeholders: `{username}` (required) and `{group}`.
Example: `{username} [Bravo]`.

shortNamePrefix.description:
Meshtastic short-name prefix, e.g. `B` for `B1`, `B2`. Unique within the event.
`null` until chosen; activation requires it.

slug.description: Stable key used by integrations, unique within the event, e.g. `bravo`.

provisioning.description: Callsign, TAK and Meshtastic settings shared by every member of the group.

version.description: Optimistic-concurrency version; send it back unchanged with updates.

provisioning.description: Optional; defaults to the plain username, Cyan, Team Member and the first slug letter.
Complete replacement of the provisioning settings.

ConfigurationSnapshot.description: Bump `schemaVersion` whenever the snapshot shape changes; old revisions are never rewritten.

created.description: `false` when the configuration was unchanged and the latest revision is returned instead.

serviceAccountBearer.description: Service-account API key. Never send it in a URL.

info.title: OpenMeshTak Core API
info.description: Authoritative API for OpenMeshTak provisioning and mission distribution.

get.description: Lists users ordered by creation time, oldest first. Requires instance-wide `users.read`.
Lists user groups ordered by creation time, oldest first. Requires `user-groups.read`.

409.description: Slug already in use

post.description: Creates a group. Callers can only grant permissions they hold themselves.

409.description: Version conflict, slug conflict or protected system group

put.description: Replaces name, slug and grants. Requires the current `version`.

409.description: Protected system group

get.description: Lists the group's members ordered by user creation time, oldest first.

put.description:
Adds a user to the group. Idempotent. The caller must hold every grant of the group, because
membership passes those grants on.

409.description: Last member of a system group

delete.description: Removes a user from the group. A system group always keeps at least one member.

get.description: Reports whether first-administrator setup has been completed. Reveals nothing else.

post.description: Creates the first password-backed administrator using the one-time operator token.

get.description: Lists service accounts ordered by creation time, oldest first.

post.description: Creates a service account with explicit permission grants.

409.description: Version conflict

put.description: Replaces name, description, status and grants. Requires the current `version`.

get.description: Lists safe API-key metadata. Key secrets are never returned after creation.

post.description:
Creates an API key and returns its complete value exactly once. Creating a key while another
is active is a rotation. Requires a recent sign-in.
Revokes an API key immediately. Repeating the request is harmless.

409.description: Configuration not published

get.description:
Resolves the member's callsign, TAK and Meshtastic identity and mission groups. Requires
`members.read`, or being that member in an active event. Draft events return an
administrator preview of the unpublished configuration.
Lists the signed-in user's memberships in active events.

Describes the authenticated caller and its effective grants. Integrations use it to verify
an API key; the Web application uses it to adapt navigation. It never replaces server-side
authorization.
Lists the event's missions ordered by creation time, oldest first.

409.description: Event archived

post.description: Creates a mission with one empty layer.

409.description: Version conflict or event archived

put.description: Replaces name and description. Requires the current `version`.

409.description: Event archived

delete.description: Deletes the mission with its layers, objects and published revisions.

get.description: Lists published revisions, oldest first, without their snapshots.

200.description: Published, or the unchanged latest revision

409.description: Event archived

get.description: Returns one revision with its snapshot.
Lists the mission's objects in creation order, optionally only those of one layer.

409.description: Layer locked, too many objects or event archived

422.description: Invalid geometry or other validation failure

409.description: Version conflict, layer locked or event archived

422.description: Invalid geometry or other validation failure

put.description: Replaces the object. Requires the current `version`.

409.description: Layer locked or event archived

get.description: Lists the mission's layers in creation order; sort by `sortOrder` for display.

409.description: Too many layers or event archived

post.description: Adds a layer on top of the existing ones.

409.description: Version conflict or event archived

put.description: Replaces name, order, visibility and lock state. Requires the current `version`.

409.description: Event archived

delete.description: Deletes the layer and all of its objects.

409.description: Layer locked, too many objects or event archived

post.description:
Imports a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, Feature or geometry into the layer. Points, lines and
polygons are supported; multi-geometries are split. The report lists every adjustment, every
skipped and every rejected feature. Request bodies are limited to 1 MB.

get.description: Exports the current draft as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection with simplestyle properties.
Exports a published revision as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection.
Lists the member's 20 most recent claims without their tokens. Requires `members.read`.

409.description: Event not active

post.description:
Issues a 24-hour single-use claim and returns its token exactly once. Earlier open claims of
the member are revoked. Requires `member-claims.create` and an active event.
Revokes an open claim immediately. Repeating the request is harmless.

403.description: The account has its own sign-in

post.description:
Exchanges a single-use participant claim for a normal browser session. The token is sent in
the body, never in the URL. Every unusable claim returns the same `401`.

get.description: Reports that the API process completed startup, including its database connection.
Lists the events the caller may read, ordered by creation time, oldest first.

parameters.description: Only return events in this lifecycle state.
parameters.name: status

409.description: Slug already in use

post.description: Creates a new event in the `draft` state. Requires instance-wide `events.manage`.

409.description: Version conflict, slug conflict or archived event

put.description:
Replaces the editable event settings. Requires the current `version`. The lifecycle state is
changed only through dedicated transitions, and archived events are read-only.

409.description: Version conflict, invalid transition or event not ready

post.description:
Moves a draft event to `active`. Requires `events.manage` and at least one event role and
one event group; unmet requirements are listed in the problem's `errors`.

409.description: Version conflict or invalid transition

post.description: Moves an active event to the read-only `archived` state. Requires `events.manage`.

409.description: Version conflict, invalid transition or event not ready

post.description:
Returns an archived event to `active` after repeating activation validation. Requires
`events.reactivate`. Revoked or expired credentials, artifacts and download grants stay
invalid; clients regenerate what they need.

get.description: Lists the event's roles ordered by creation time, oldest first.

409.description: Slug already in use or event archived
Version conflict, slug conflict or event archived

put.description: Replaces name, slug and description. Requires the current `version`.

409.description: Event archived or role still assigned to members

get.description: Lists synchronizations that could not be resolved, oldest first. Requires `members.read`.

parameters.description: Only return issues in this state.
parameters.name: status

200.description: Membership resolved or issue still open

409.description: Issue not open or event archived

post.description:
Re-evaluates an open issue against the event's current roles and groups. Requires
`members.manage`. A callsign override resolves a callsign conflict for this member.

200.description: Membership resolved or sync issue recorded

409.description: Event archived

put.description:
Idempotently creates or updates the event membership of an external identity. Requires
`members.sync` for the event. When the role or group slug does not exist, the response
contains a sync issue instead and nothing else changes. Synchronization never creates a
password, login, email address or session.

get.description: Lists the event's members ordered by creation time, oldest first. Requires `members.read`.

409.description: Already a member, callsign or short-name conflict, or event archived

post.description:
Adds an existing OpenMeshTak user to the event. Members from external systems use the
external-member upsert instead. Requires `members.manage`.

409.description: Version conflict, callsign or short-name conflict, or event archived

put.description:
Replaces the member's event role, event group and callsign override. Requires the current
`version` and `members.manage`. An integration sync may later set role and group again.

409.description: Event archived

delete.description:
Removes the member from this event only. The user and other event participations remain.
Requires `members.manage`.

get.description: Lists the event's groups ordered by creation time, oldest first.

409.description: Slug already in use or event archived
Version conflict, slug conflict or event archived

put.description: Replaces name, slug and description. Requires the current `version`.

409.description: Event archived or group still assigned to members

get.description: Lists revisions oldest first. Requires `events.read`.

409.description: Event not active

post.description:
Publishes the current configuration of an active event. Returns the latest revision with
`created: false` when nothing changed. Requires `events.manage`.
